items.title: 12.3.3 Continuity of a Function at a Point (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Ab tak humne limit aur one-sided limits seekhin. Ab inhi se ek bohat ahem concept banta hai: continuity (musalsal hona). Asaan alfaaz mein, function kisi point par continuous hai jab us ka graph wahan bina toote guzarta hai. Lekin "bina toote" ko maths mein saabit kaise karein? Is ke liye kitab teen saaf shartein deti hai. Aaj hum yahi shartein aur chaar misaalein dekhenge.

Kitab ki definition: function \(f\) number "\(c\)" par continuous kehlata hai agar aur sirf agar yeh teen shartein (conditions) poori hon:

(i) \(f(c)\) is defined
(ii) \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x)\) exists
(iii) \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = f(c)\)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Har shart kis cheez se bachati hai, yeh samajh lein to definition ratta nahin lagani paregi:
(i) \(f(c)\) defined ho: \(x = c\) par graph ka koi point maujood ho, yani wahan soorakh (hole) na ho.
(ii) Limit exist kare: graph ke left aur right hisse ek hi height ki taraf ja rahe hon, yani chhalaang (jump) na ho.
(iii) Limit \(= f(c)\): \(x = c\) wala point bilkul wahin baitha ho jahan curve ja raha hai, yani koi point apni jagah se hata hua na ho.
Mukhtasar: \(c\) par continuity ka matlab hai ke aap \(x = c\) se graph pencil uthaye baghair guzaar sakte hain.
Kitab kehti hai: agar "\(c\)" par in teen shartoun mein se ek ya zyada poori na hon, to function \(f\) "\(c\)" par discontinuous (toota hua) kehlata hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Har sawal mein kaam ki tarteeb yeh rakhiye: pehle (i), phir (ii), phir (iii). Jo pehli shart fail ho wahin ruk jayein aur saaf likhein ke kaun si shart fail hui. Agar teeno poori hon to function continuous hai.
Polynomial (jaise Example 12) har real \(c\) par hamesha continuous hota hai, kyun ke us ki limit substitution se nikalti hai, aur substitution bilkul \(f(c)\) hi deta hai. Yani shart (iii) apne aap poori ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Discontinuity ko teen tasveeron mein yaad rakhiye:
1. Soorakh (hole): curve chal raha hai magar ek point ghayab hai. Limit exist karti hai, sirf \(f(c)\) nahin hai ya ghalat jagah hai. Isay bhar kar function continuous banaya ja sakta hai, jaise Example 13(a) mein value 6 de kar kiya gaya.
2. Chhalaang (jump): left aur right tukde alag alag heights par khatam hote hain. Limit hi exist nahin karti; ek point ki value badalne se yeh theek nahin hota.
3. Hata hua point: limit exist karti hai aur \(f(c)\) bhi defined hai, magar dono barabar nahin; point curve se upar ya neeche alag baitha hai.
Agli dafa koi sawal dekhein to pehle andaaza lagaiye ke in teeno mein se kaun si soorat ho sakti hai; phir shartein check kar ke tasdeeq kijiye.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Example 11 aur 13(b) mein function ka formula \(\frac{\text{kuch}}{x - c}\) jaisa hai. Aise mein pehla sawal hamesha yeh hai: kya \(x = c\) rakhne se denominator zero hota hai? Agar haan, aur alag se \(f(c)\) ki value nahin di gayi, to shart (i) wahin fail ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Ab chaar misaalein aa rahi hain, aur har ek continuity ka alag pehlu dikhati hai: Example 11 mein shart (i) fail hoti hai (soorakh); Example 12 mein teeno shartein poori hoti hain (polynomial); Example 13 mein ek hi formula ke do functions hain, ek continuous aur ek nahin; aur Example 14 mein shart (ii) fail hoti hai (chhalaang). In chaaron ko samajh lein to is topic ka har sawal aap ke qaboo mein hoga.

blocks.title: Example 11
blocks.problem: Consider the function \(f(x) = \frac{x^{2}-1}{x-1}\), discuss the continuity of \(f\) at \(x = 1\).
steps:
Given: \(f(x) = \frac{x^{2}-1}{x-1}\).
To find: kya \(f\), \(x = 1\) par continuous hai.
Method: continuity ki teeno shartein tarteeb se check karte hain; jaise hi koi ek shart fail ho, function discontinuous hai, aage dekhne ki zaroorat nahin.

Step 1: Shart (i): kya \(f(1)\) defined hai?
\[f(1) = \dfrac{1^{2}-1}{1-1} = \dfrac{0}{0}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{0}{0}\) koi number nahin hai, kyun ke zero se divide karna defined hi nahin. Sochiye: \(\frac{6}{2} = 3\) is liye ke \(3 \times 2 = 6\); lekin \(\frac{0}{0}\) ke liye har number \(\times\ 0 = 0\) deta hai, to koi ek jawab hai hi nahin. Is liye \(f(1)\) defined nahin, yani graph par \(x = 1\) ka koi point nahin.

Step 2: Natija
Shart (i) fail ho gayi, is liye \(f(x)\), \(x = 1\) par discontinuous hai.
Kyun: continuity ke liye teeno shartein zaroori hain; ek ka fail hona discontinuity ke liye kaafi hai. Is liye kitab yahin ruk jati hai aur limit nahin nikaalti. Imtihaan mein bhi itna likhna kaafi hai, lekin neeche tasdeeq mein hum dekhenge ke limit hoti kya hai, taa ke tasveer saaf ho jaye.

Tasdeeq: limit khud to exist karti hai,
\[\lim_{x \to 1} \dfrac{(x-1)(x+1)}{x-1} = \lim_{x \to 1}(x+1)\]
\[= 2\]
lekin graph par \(x = 1\) wala point maujood hi nahin: graph line \(y = x + 1\) hai jis mein \((1, 2)\) par ek soorakh (hole) hai. Is liye function phir bhi discontinuous hai.
blocks.answer: \(f(1)\) defined nahin, is liye \(f(x)\), \(x = 1\) par discontinuous hai.

blocks.title: Example 12
steps:
Given: \(f(x) = 3x^{2} - 5x + 4\).
To find: kya \(f\), \(x = 1\) par continuous hai.
Method: \(\lim_{x \to 1} f(x)\) aur \(f(1)\) dono nikaal kar muqabla karte hain (shartein (i)-(iii)).

Step 1: Limit
\[\lim_{x \to 1} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 1} (3x^{2} - 5x + 4)\]
\[= 3 - 5 + 4 = 2\]
Kyun: \(f\) ek polynomial hai, aur theorems on limits ke mutabiq polynomial ki limit seedha \(x = 1\) rakhne se mil jati hai: \(3(1)^{2} - 5(1) + 4\). Limit exist karti hai: shart (ii).

Step 2: Value
\[f(1) = 3 - 5 + 4 = 2\]
Kyun: \(f(1)\) ek real number hai, is liye shart (i) poori. Polynomial mein koi denominator ya square root nahin hota, is liye har \(x\) par us ki value nikal aati hai.

Step 3: Muqabla
\[\lim_{x \to 1} f(x) = f(1) = 2\]
Is liye \(f(x)\), \(x = 1\) par continuous hai.
Kyun: teeno shartein poori hain; (iii) yahi hai ke limit aur value barabar hon. Graph ki zabaan mein: parabola \(x = 1\) par point \((1, 2)\) se bina toote guzarta hai.

Tasdeeq: 1 ke qareeb values 2 ke qareeb hain:
\[f(0.99) = 1.9903,\quad f(1.01) = 2.0103\]
blocks.answer: \(\lim_{x \to 1} f(x) = f(1) = 2\), is liye \(f(x)\), \(x = 1\) par continuous hai.

blocks.title: Example 13
blocks.problem:
Discuss the continuity of the functions \(f(x)\) and \(g(x)\) at \(x = 3\)
(a) \[f(x) = \begin{cases} \dfrac{x^{2}-9}{x-3} & \text{if } x \ne 3 \\ 6 & \text{if } x = 3 \end{cases}\]
(b) \[g(x) = \dfrac{x^{2}-9}{x-3} \ \text{ if } x \ne 3\]
steps:
Given: upar diye hue \(f\) aur \(g\); dono \(x \ne 3\) ke liye \(\frac{x^{2}-9}{x-3}\) hain, lekin \(f(3) = 6\) diya gaya hai jab ke \(g\) ki 3 par koi value nahin.
To find: kya \(f\) aur \(g\), \(x = 3\) par continuous hain.
Method: teeno shartein check karte hain; limit ke liye \(x^{2} - 9\) ko factorise kar ke \(x - 3\) cancel karenge, kyun ke seedha rakhne se \(\frac{0}{0}\) aata hai.

(a) Step 1: Shart (i)
\[f(3) = 6\]
Kyun: definition ki doosri line seedha \(x = 3\) par value de rahi hai. Dhyan dein: \(f(3)\) nikaalne ke liye pehla formula use nahin karna, kyun ke woh sirf \(x \ne 3\) ke liye hai.

(a) Step 2: Shart (ii), limit
\[\lim_{x \to 3} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 3} \dfrac{x^{2}-9}{x-3}\]
\[= \lim_{x \to 3} \dfrac{(x+3)(x-3)}{x-3}\]
\[= \lim_{x \to 3} (x+3)\]
\[= 3 + 3 = 6\]
Kyun: 3 ke qareeb (magar \(x \ne 3\)) pehla formula lagta hai. Seedha 3 rakhein to \(\frac{0}{0}\) aata hai, is liye difference of squares \(x^{2} - 9 = (x+3)(x-3)\) use kar ke \(x - 3\) cancel kiya. Yeh cancel karna jaiz hai kyun ke limit mein \(x\) sirf 3 ke qareeb jata hai, 3 ke barabar nahin hota, to \(x - 3 \ne 0\).

(a) Step 3: Shart (iii)
\[\lim_{x \to 3} f(x) = 6 = f(3)\]
Is liye \(f(x)\), \(x = 3\) par continuous hai. Graph mein koi break nahin.
Kyun: teeno shartein poori ho gayin. Yani function ne us soorakh ko, jo pehle formula mein \(x = 3\) par hota, bilkul sahi value 6 de kar bhar diya hai.

(b) Step 4: \(g\) ke liye shart (i)
\(g\), \(x = 3\) par defined nahin (us ka formula sirf \(x \ne 3\) ke liye hai).
\(\Rightarrow g(x)\), \(x = 3\) par discontinuous hai.
Kyun: shart (i) fail ho gayi. Limit ab bhi 6 hai (hisaab (a) jaisa), lekin point \((3, g(3))\) maujood hi nahin, is liye graph mein \(x = 3\) par break (soorakh) hai.

Tasdeeq: \(x \ne 3\) ke liye dono functions \(x + 3\) ke barabar hain; maslan
\[f(2) = \dfrac{4-9}{2-3} = 5 = 2 + 3\]
Dono ke graphs line \(y = x + 3\) hain; \(f\) point \((3, 6)\) ko bhar deta hai, \(g\) use khaali chhor deta hai.
blocks.answer: (a) \(f(x)\), \(x = 3\) par continuous hai (\(\lim_{x \to 3} f(x) = 6 = f(3)\)). (b) \(g(x)\), \(x = 3\) par discontinuous hai (\(g(3)\) defined nahin).

blocks.alt: Graph of f: axes from O along x and y. The straight line y = x + 3 passes through the dots (0, 3), (2, 5), (3, 6) and (4, 7); a dashed line drops from (3, 6) to the x-axis. The line has no break.
blocks.caption: Figure: Example 13(a), graph of f, no break at x = 3 (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.alt: Graph of g: axes with arrows (no letters, as printed). The line y = x + 3 with an arrow passes through the dots (0, 3), (2, 5) and (4, 7) and has an open circle (a hole) at (3, 6), because g is not defined at x = 3; a dashed line drops from the hole to the x-axis.
blocks.caption: Figure: Example 13(b), graph of g, a hole at (3, 6) (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Example 13(b) wale graph mein point \((3, 6)\) bhara hua (solid) dot bana hai aur line bina toote dikhayi gayi hai, halaan ke \(g\), \(x = 3\) par defined nahin aur kitab ka text khud kehta hai ke wahan graph mein break hai. Sahi yeh hai ke \((3, 6)\) khaali daira (open circle, yani soorakh) ho, jaisa hamari drawing mein hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Example 13 ka sabaq bohat ahem hai: \(f\) aur \(g\) ka formula bilkul ek jaisa hai, farq sirf ek point ka hai. \(f\) ne soorakh ko value 6 de kar bhar diya, is liye continuous ho gaya; \(g\) ne soorakh khaali chhor diya, is liye discontinuous raha. Yani kabhi kabhi sirf ek point ki value poore function ko continuous ya discontinuous bana deti hai.

blocks.title: Example 14
blocks.problem:
Discuss continuity of \(f(x)\) at \(x = 3\), when
\[f(x) = \begin{cases} x - 1, & \text{if } x < 3 \\ 2x + 1, & \text{if } 3 \le x \end{cases}\]
steps:
Given: \(f(x) = x - 1\) jab \(x < 3\), aur \(f(x) = 2x + 1\) jab \(x \ge 3\).
To find: kya \(f\), \(x = 3\) par continuous hai.
Method: \(x = 3\) par formula badalta hai, is liye pehle \(f(3)\), phir left aur right hand limits (12.3.2 ki kasauti), phir muqabla.

Step 1: Shart (i)
\[f(3) = 2(3) + 1 = 7\]
Shart (i) poori hai.
Kyun: \(x = 3\) shart \(3 \le x\) poori karta hai (3 barabar hai 3 ke), is liye value doosre formula se aati hai. Pehla formula sirf \(x < 3\) ke liye hai, us mein 3 shamil nahin.

Step 2: Left hand limit
\[\lim_{x \to 3^{-}} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 3^{-}} (x - 1)\]
\[= 3 - 1 = 2\]
Kyun: \(x < 3\) ke liye pehla formula lagta hai. Left se aate hue \(x\) kabhi 3 tak nahin pohanchta, is liye doosre formula ka yahan koi kirdar nahin.

Step 3: Right hand limit
\[\lim_{x \to 3^{+}} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 3^{+}} (2x + 1)\]
\[= 6 + 1 = 7\]
Kyun: \(x > 3\) ke liye doosra formula lagta hai. \(2x + 1\) polynomial hai, is liye seedha 3 rakh diya: \(2(3) + 1 = 7\).

Step 4: Shart (ii)
\[\lim_{x \to 3^{-}} f(x) \ne \lim_{x \to 3^{+}} f(x)\]
Yani shart (ii) poori nahin: \(\lim_{x \to 3} f(x)\) exist nahin karti.
Is liye \(f(x)\), \(x = 3\) par continuous nahin.
Kyun: \(2 \ne 7\); 12.3.2 ki kasauti ke mutabiq limit exist nahin karti, aur limit na ho to shart (ii) fail. Note karein: \(f(3)\) defined hone ke bawajood function discontinuous hai.
Tasdeeq: neeche graph dekhiye: \(x = 3\) par height 2 (left tukda, khula sira) se height 7 (right tukda, bhara hua sira) tak chhalaang hai; maslan \(f(2.99) = 1.99\) aur \(f(3.01) = 7.02\).
blocks.answer: Left hand limit 2 aur right hand limit 7 hai, is liye \(\lim_{x \to 3} f(x)\) exist nahin karti; \(f(x)\), \(x = 3\) par continuous nahin.

blocks.alt: Graph of f on axes x and y with unit ticks: the line y = x minus 1 for x less than 3 ends at an open circle at (3, 2); the line y = 2x + 1 for x at least 3 starts at a filled dot at (3, 7). Dashed lines join 2 and 7 on the y-axis to x = 3, and x = 3 to the x-axis. Labels O, 2, 7 and 3.
blocks.caption: Figure: Example 14, a jump at x = 3 (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka hal graph ko "figure (iii)" kehta hai, magar figure par koi number nahin. Us graph mein left tukde ka sira \((3, 2)\) bhara hua dot bana hai; lekin \(f(3) = 7\) hai, is liye \((3, 2)\) graph par nahin aur wahan khaali daira (open circle) hona chahiye, jaisa hamari drawing mein hai. Bhara hua dot sirf \((3, 7)\) par aata hai.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Graph banate waqt khaali daira (open circle) aur bhara hua dot (filled dot) ka farq bohat ahem hai. Khaali daira ka matlab: line yahan tak aati hai magar yeh point graph ka hissa nahin. Bhara hua dot ka matlab: yeh point graph par hai, yani function ki value yahi hai. Example 14 mein \(f(3) = 7\), is liye \((3, 7)\) bhara hua aur \((3, 2)\) khaali. Imtihaan mein graph banayein to yeh farq zaroor dikhayein.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh kitab ka sawal nahin, practice ke liye hai. \(f(x) = x^{2}\) jab \(x < 2\), aur \(f(x) = 4x - 4\) jab \(x \ge 2\). Kya \(f\), \(x = 2\) par continuous hai?
Soch: (i) \(f(2) = 4(2) - 4 = 4\), defined. (ii) Left se \(2^{2} = 4\), right se \(4(2) - 4 = 4\); dono barabar, limit 4. (iii) Limit \(4 = f(2)\). Teeno shartein poori, is liye continuous. Graph ke dono tukde \((2, 4)\) par aa kar mil jate hain.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Example 11 mein agar hum \(f(1) = 2\) alag se define kar dein, to kya function \(x = 1\) par continuous ho jayega? (Jawab: haan, kyun ke limit bhi 2 hai; bilkul Example 13(a) ki tarah soorakh bhar jayega.) Aur agar \(f(1) = 5\) rakhein to? (Phir shart (iii) fail: limit \(2 \ne 5\).)

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Jawab mein teeno shartein likhiye aur har ek ke saamne saaf likhiye ke poori hui ya nahin: "(i) \(f(3) = 7\) defined; (ii) LHL \(= 2\), RHL \(= 7\), limit exist nahin karti; is liye discontinuous." Kaun si shart fail hui, yeh saaf likhna poore marks dilata hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(f\), \(c\) par continuous hai agar aur sirf agar (i) \(f(c)\) defined ho, (ii) \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x)\) exist kare, (iii) \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = f(c)\).
2. Koi ek shart bhi fail ho to \(f\), \(c\) par discontinuous hai.
3. Break ki teen qismein: soorakh (Examples 11, 13(b)), chhalaang (Example 14), aur hata hua point (limit exist kare magar \(\ne f(c)\)).
4. Polynomial har real number par continuous hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. "Limit exist karti hai, is liye continuous hai" kehna: Example 11 mein limit 2 hai magar \(f(1)\) defined hi nahin.
2. "\(f(c)\) defined hai, is liye continuous hai" kehna: Example 14 mein \(f(3) = 7\) hai magar limit exist nahin karti.
3. \(x - 3\) cancel kar ke \(f(3)\) nikaal lena: \(f(3)\) sirf function ki definition se aata hai, simplify kiye hue formula se nahin. Cancel karna sirf limit ke liye jaiz hai.
